selection_rule: evaluate every frozen prompt/seed cell once; rank candidates on development seeds by quality-pass count, then correction RMS, then shorter horizon; report the selected candidate only if all preregistered development, holdout, overall, and preservation floors pass

correction.root_xy_and_yaw: apply one rigid horizontal-frame transform to the entire second chunk
correction.root_z: apply C1 decay only when the seam displacement exceeds 0.05 m
correction.joints: apply C1 decay per channel only when seam displacement exceeds 0.5 rad or seam velocity residual exceeds 0.15 rad/frame
